text:
lauren: Quick heads-up — targeting deploy for "contextual-ranking-v2" to preprod and prod tomorrow 2025-10-12 22:00 UTC. Need: deploy owner, preprod smoke, prod smoke, rollback tested, support/CS blurb for release notes. Ping owners below.

devon: I'll be deploy owner for the preprod->prod cutover. On call from 21:30 UTC. Can someone confirm there are no DB migrations? @sam

sam: No DB migrations. It's a config + model variant push only. Verified with infra: no schema changes. :white_check_mark:

marta: I'll draft the CS/marketing blurb — ETA today EOD PST. Any customer-impact phrasing? Should we explicitly say "no downtime expected"?

lauren: Correct — no downtime expected. Main risk: 5xxs from tokenization edge-case; rollback plan is immediate model pin to v1.9 and scale down canary. @oncall-bot can you schedule the deploy window in calendar?

oncall-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2025-10-12T22:00:00Z — 2025-10-12T23:00:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234

devon: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% if metrics OK. SLO checks: p50<80ms, error rate <0.5%, token-per-sec CPU under threshold. I'll run smoke scripts. @sam can you make sure alerting keys are set?

sam: Alerts are set. Smoke script lives in repo at infra/deploy/smoke.sh. Quick run command to validate preprod: 

```bash
./infra/deploy/smoke.sh --env preprod --warm 3 --rps 10
```

lauren: CS/Support: @naya can you prepare the rollout note and support playbook? Include rollback steps: 

- pin model: `models.pin --model contextual-ranking --version v1.9`
- scale canary to 0

naya: Yep — will prepare playbook and handoff doc. Will add steps for running smoke.sh and for inspecting traces in Console. ETA ~60m.

devon: Code owners: merge is green, CR approvals done. Tagging release artifact: `docker:ghcr.redwood/contextual-ranking:2025-10-12-rc3`

marta: Marketing: short tweet + docs update. Will add "no customer-facing API changes" language. Coordinating with CS for approval.

lauren: One more ask — verify A/B experiment flags are off in prod before rollout (feature-gate: ranking-ab). @alex can you confirm?

alex: Confirmed gates are off. Preparing cold-start nodes and will monitor GPU mem and queue lengths.

devon: If anything fails during canary, immediate rollback and page infra oncall, then run postmortem. I'll be ready to execute.

marta: Draft blurb posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/contextual-ranking-v2-draft — PTAL @lauren @naya

lauren: LGTM :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll post final release notes once CS approves. Locking the deploy window.

naya: Support doc done: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/contextual-ranking-rollout — includes rollback commands and metric checks.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 30m. Good luck!
